required_evidence: Test surjectivity of the inverse-limit map under the supplied tower hypotheses.
Any obstruction or counterexample must preserve finite C_n and the two stated surjectivity assumptions.
If discussing freedom of lifts, distinguish nonempty torsor from a chosen canonical lift.
critical_errors: Assume inverse limits are right exact from levelwise exactness.
Transfer surjectivity of B or C transitions to A transitions.
Apply finite-set compactness to infinite lift fibers.
Infer existence from uniqueness or from solvability of all finite prefixes.
completion_policy: A valid counterexample refuting the proposed universal target resolves that target. Record constructive progress separately; do not require the author route or every baseline lemma.
open_task_policy: Accept independently verified alternative constructions, counterexamples and unexpected results. Explicit conditional results are valid contributions; silently promoting their scope is not. Honest incompleteness is distinct from an invalid proof.
